claim: Recycling the Winter Cabins so villagers would drink more Wheatshine for Heat killed the children: they cannot drink Wheatshine.

evidence.reference: Player posts on the Outlanders community Discord, early November 2026.

notes: Matches the data: Wheatshine is ConsumedByChildren false, ConsumedByAdults true, with Heat 4 units. Heat is the only need with a death value (−50, cause Cold). The Winter Cabin warms 4 sleeping spots and the Bonfire 8 social spots. A Coat has AdultsOnly false and raises Heat's floor to −50 + 129 = 79, so children wearing one cannot freeze (research docs/NEEDS.md).
